outlet: The Malta Business Weekly (Silvan Mifsud); Amphora Media
note: ◆ CBM Policy Note 1/2025 as summarised by MBW ('The native Maltese population stood at 405,075 persons in 2023'); Amphora (6 Nov 2025) gives the same figure. Equals Eurostat's Maltese citizens on 1 January 2024 (first-hand).
◆ MBW: under the baseline the native population 'is expected to fall from around 405,000 persons in 2023 to about 350,000 persons by 2050'. The CBM note itself was not readable (403).
◆ Amphora: 'It is projected to decline to about 347,000 in 2050'. Amphora also reports that the note leaves out people who acquired citizenship by naturalisation or investment.
